verdict.rationale: Salesforce's own pages say Sales Cloud gives reps "AI-powered insights" and show AI-generated lead scoring inside the CRM view, with Predictive Forecasting and Lead Scoring listed as features. That covers the core of getting AI insights from your data inside the product, but the evidence is marketing-level. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how insights and next-step suggestions are generated and shown, explicit evidence of actionable recommendations beyond scoring and forecasting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Equip reps with real-time data and AI-powered insights so they can cut through the noise
AI-generated lead scoring within a CRM view
Surface insights to speed up prospecting and opportunity management.
